# Janjua's English Lit Notes

> English literature study guides by Qaisar Iqbal Janjua: exam study editions of the English literature works taught worldwide, for students in schools, colleges and universities wherever English literature is taught. Every book gives the complete original text with a plain modern English line under every line, word notes, model answers for every unit and twelve model essays.

Status: three books are ready and coming soon on Amazon as a paperback (6 x 9 in) and a Kindle ebook. There are no buy links, prices or release dates yet. Free PDF samples are available now. The series is an independent study aid, not affiliated with any university, examination board or publisher.

## Books

- [The General Prologue to The Canterbury Tales: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/general-prologue-study-guide/): General Prologue study guide. Original author: Geoffrey Chaucer. Text: Skeat's edition (Oxford, 1900), lines 1 to 858. 24 units (one for each pilgrim or section of the poem), 12 model essays, 180 objective questions, a bank of 40 quotations, 26 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 351 pages; Kindle ebook. Coming soon on Amazon.
- [Hamlet: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/hamlet-study-guide/): Hamlet study guide. Original author: William Shakespeare. Text: the Cambridge Shakespeare, edited by W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright (1866). 17 units (one for each scene or group of scenes), 12 model essays, 145 objective questions, a bank of 48 quotations, 15 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 558 pages; Kindle ebook. Coming soon on Amazon.
- [Macbeth: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/macbeth-study-guide/): Macbeth study guide. Original author: William Shakespeare. Text: the Cambridge Shakespeare, edited by W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright (Volume VII, Macmillan, 1865). 13 units (one for each scene or group of scenes), 12 model essays, 105 objective questions, a bank of 40 key passages, 14 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 367 pages; Kindle ebook. Coming soon on Amazon.
- [The books compared](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/): all three books side by side.

## What every book contains

- The complete original text, with plain modern English for every line and word notes beneath.
- Units by section or scene, each with a character or scene card, a background box, a critical note, three short answers, a model context answer and five objective questions.
- Twelve model essays on the questions examiners set most often, each with a marked shorter version.
- Practice questions, one-line facts, a bank of key quotations or passages and a last-night checklist.
- Original drawings of every character, in one house style.
- Every quotation and line number is checked against the source edition.

## About and contact
